description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline version, January 2023 universe, schema/coding rules, licensing, and original source status have not been checked. Open-web candidates are not official rows and no absence claim is made.
required_followup: Coordinator should compare the frozen candidates and evidence with the authorized original dataset and codebook before any consolidation or official-status language.

description: Attendance is unquantified for the bank-depositor action, Luyi fireworks-ban crowd, Yancheng nurses' strike, and Luochuan hospital gathering. ‘Large group,’ ‘crowds,’ and ‘collectively’ do not establish a numeric minimum. The 300+ Luochuan temporary staff and roughly 100 Wuning workers are affected-workforce figures, not protesters.
required_followup: Seek event-specific direct counts or clear qualitative estimates from identifiable reports/video. Keep affected-worker, injury, vehicle, arrest, and police counts separate from attendee counts.

description: The own-state/policy target is unresolved for several labor and depositor actions. Bank depositors petitioned at a reported regulator venue but slogans addressed banks; Chongqing grievances name a private employer/dispatch agencies and state negotiations are only a response; hospital workers' insurance grievances could concern employer compliance without an explicit state demand.
required_followup: Look for event-specific slogans, petition text, or direct reporting that identifies demands to a Chinese government body or policy; do not treat police/government negotiation or employer ownership as sufficient by itself.

description: Physical event boundaries are uncertain for the New Year's Day depositor mobilization: reports describe many people traveling from several places, a highway march toward Zhengzhou, and a subset petitioning at the regulator. Campaign continuity from 2022 is explicit, but it does not prove that every arrival/action was one meeting. RFA also notes a Nanjing crowd at a Sun Yat-sen statue on 31 December 2022 without establishing it as a protest or January continuation.
required_followup: Identify exact sites and sequence, compare with prior-month physical episodes, and keep the Nanjing lead outside January unless a protest and continuation are established.

description: Start dates are reported for the five candidates, but no source establishes a physical end date for any gathering/strike. A separate Wuning loader-at-gate account is tied to a 15 January social-media post rather than a verified action date, so it is excluded from events pending a dated source.
required_followup: Find event-specific reports on when each physical action ended. For Wuning, locate the original post/video and establish its physical action date before assigning a month.

description: Response details remain source-limited: Luyi's six arrests are attributed to a police statement; RFA reports that some bank petitioners were taken to a police station but does not independently verify the claim; NTD reports police tried to disperse Luochuan staff and alleges shoving, while a video voice's beating claim is unverified. No-event silence is not coded as ‘ignore.’
required_followup: Seek event-specific independent accounts or official statements and distinguish police presence, dispersal, transport to a station, formal arrest, and alleged beating.

description: The two bank-depositor articles cite online video/social accounts and do not provide independent event verification; RFA expressly says it could not verify the messages/videos. NTD's Luochuan, Yancheng, and Wuning lead is one roundup based on social posts/videos. RFA's Chongqing attendance caption attributes the word ‘hundreds’ to Reuters, whose article was not opened.
required_followup: Map each article to its original video/interview/newswire, check syndicated or shared-source relationships, and avoid counting outlet copies as independent corroboration.

description: Most opened material was in simplified Chinese; the Luyi RFA page is an English translation that credits a Mandarin original. No independent translation check or additional non-English regional news search was completed.
required_followup: Check source-language pages and relevant regional-language reporting if the coordinator needs stronger event confirmation; preserve attributed wording and translation uncertainty.

description: This was a bounded open-web first pass across general, weekly, labor, bank, fireworks, health-insurance, and regional/local Chinese and English queries. It is not exhaustive across China's provinces, platforms, or language variants, and search visibility may be affected by censorship/deletion. Q001-Q013 search headers are preserved; no LexisNexis or systematic newspaper/archive access was used.
required_followup: If broader coverage is needed, run an independently documented archive/database search with region- and sector-specific Chinese terms and compare it with this captured query set.

description: Several claims are explicitly unverified or attributed to social-media videos: the bank-destination and yellow-code account, Luochuan police-beating allegation, and Wuning action date/loader account. These have been preserved as reported claims rather than verified outcomes.
required_followup: Review original public posts/videos or independent contemporary reporting; resolve source and date before upgrading any claim.
